question: Provide a detailed web sales report for each region, including the number of orders, total sales amount, and the name and sales amount of all sales representatives who achieved the highest total sales amount in that region (include all representatives in case of a tie).
sql:
WITH region_rep_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    r.id as region_id,
    r.name as region_name,
    sr.id as rep_id,
    sr.name as rep_name,
    SUM(o.total_amt_usd) as rep_total_sales
  FROM web_orders o
  JOIN web_accounts a ON o.account_id = a.id
  JOIN web_sales_reps sr ON a.sales_rep_id = sr.id
  JOIN web_region r ON sr.region_id = r.id
  GROUP BY r.id, r.name, sr.id, sr.name
),
region_max_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    region_id,
    MAX(rep_total_sales) as max_sales
  FROM region_rep_sales
  GROUP BY region_id
),
region_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    r.id as region_id,
    r.name as region_name,
    COUNT(*) as order_count,
    SUM(o.total_amt_usd) as total_sales
  FROM web_orders o
  JOIN web_accounts a ON o.account_id = a.id
  JOIN web_sales_reps sr ON a.sales_rep_id = sr.id
  JOIN web_region r ON sr.region_id = r.id
  GROUP BY r.id, r.name
)
SELECT 
  rt.region_name,
  rt.order_count,
  rt.total_sales,
  rss.rep_name,
  rss.rep_total_sales as top_rep_sales
FROM region_totals rt
JOIN region_rep_sales rss ON rt.region_id = rss.region_id
JOIN region_max_sales rms ON rss.region_id = rms.region_id AND rss.rep_total_sales = rms.max_sales
ORDER BY rt.region_name, rss.rep_name
